scenes.setting: In the moving carriage, the defectors' story: an ancient Southern-Continent order fallen to bloody indulgence — Sharron and Maric's creed of repression against it; the price of their Book of Secrets is joining a hunt to kill the Sequence 5 pursuer with the Sharron-restraining Sealed Artifact — Maric first bait, Sharron second, Klein the hunter with the 'eye'
scenes.text_anchor: “Our philosophy is to repress and show temperance.”
